config.script:
headers = ["Sr.No", "Issue", "RaisedOn","Category"]

    data = [
        ["1", "FPY Drop", "18-Apr-2026","Quality"],
        ["2", "Rejection / Scrap increase", "18 Apr 2026","Quality"],
        ["3", "Customer complaints received", "17 Apr 2026","Quality"],
        ["4", "Process deviation from standard", "17 Apr 2026","Quality"]
    ]

    ds = system.dataset.toDataSet(headers, data)

    excel = system.dataset.toExcel(True, [ds])

    system.perspective.download(
        filename="Issue_Report.xlsx",
        data=excel
     )

container = self.parent.getChild("CoordinateContainer")

    if container.position.display:
        container.position.display = False
        self.props.text = "Show Filter"
    else:
        container.position.display = True
        self.props.text = "Hide Filter"

row = event.row
    colIndex = event.column
    value = event.value

    rowData = self.props.data[row]
    record_id = rowData["id"]

    # Get actual field name from columns config
    colConfig = self.props.columns[colIndex]
    db_col = colConfig["field"]

    allowed = ["event_date", "due_date", "issue", "action", "person_responsible"]

    if db_col not in allowed:
        return

    query = "UPDATE issues_log SET " + db_col + " = ? WHERE id = ?"

    system.db.runPrepUpdate(
        query,
        [value, record_id],
        "Dev_MSSQL_Server"
    )

    self.refreshBinding("props.data")

messageHandlers.script:
if payload.get("id"):
        system.db.runPrepUpdate(
            "UPDATE issues_log SET status = ? WHERE id = ?",
            [payload["value"], payload["id"]],
            "Dev_MSSQL_Server"
        )
        self.getChild("AS").getChild("AT").getChild("IssuesTable").refreshBinding("props.data")
